item.text:
Updated [ec2.go](/app/lib/utils/ec2.go) so `IsAvailable` retrieves the IMDS instance ID within 250 ms and accepts only valid EC2 instance ID formats. Client creation now supports functional options, including `WithIMDSClient` for injecting a custom metadata client.

Added regression coverage in [ec2_test.go](/app/lib/utils/ec2_test.go) for captive portal HTML, malformed IDs, option errors, and timeout behavior. `go test ./lib/utils -count=1` passes.
